implementation_status: partial: unregistered MOFA2 train, save and reload path. Sol reproduced one synthetic smoke. The packet is not accepted. AC2-AC4 remain open.

isolated_environment.result: MOFA2 1.22.1 and mofapy2 0.7.5 load from those prefixes. The user library was not modified.

integration_backends.native_fit: MOFA2::run_mofa writes the HDF5 outfile; MOFA2::load_model reloads it. Gaussian views, observed-value scaling, and save/reload agreement are required before trained=TRUE.
integration_backends.native_prediction: not supported; core MOFA makes no new-subject prediction claim
integration_backends.common_result: not produced; the unavailable state carries no factors, weights or variance

method_name_note: The packet brief named this method mixomics_mofa. This request uses mofa2 to match the existing config schema enum, the C-01 registration deferral and the spec draft. MOFA2 is not a mixOmics method. Sol to confirm the name before shared registration.
